schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension (IGNOAPS)
schemes.benefit: Monthly pension: central share Rs 200 (age 60-79) or Rs 500 (80+), plus state top-up
conditions_met: Applicant must belong to a Below Poverty Line household

documents.name: Age proof (birth certificate, school record or Aadhaar)
BPL ration card or BPL certificate

schemes.name: Chief Minister Animal Health Scheme
schemes.benefit: Provides mobile veterinary health services at the doorstep of farmers.
conditions_met: The scheme is intended for animal rearers/farmers.
check_yourself: Unreviewed extraction: verify all mandatory conditions on the official source.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Gramin
schemes.benefit: Financial assistance of 1.20 lakh rupees for construction or upgrading of houses for vulnerable sections.
conditions_met: Beneficiary must have resided in Maharashtra for at least 15 years.
The beneficiary must be a resident of Maharashtra.
Family annual income must be less than 1,20,000.
check_yourself: Beneficiary must be homeless or have no fixed house.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Rural
schemes.benefit: Financial assistance for construction of houses for the poor and homeless.
conditions_met: The scheme is intended for citizens below the poverty line.
check_yourself: Beneficiaries are selected from a permanent waiting list prepared by the Gram Sabha
schemes.how_to_apply: Beneficiaries are selected from a permanent waiting list prepared by the Gram Sabha

schemes.name: Establishment of Entrepreneurs for breed development of Rural Poultry
schemes.benefit: One time 50 percent capital subsidy up to a maximum limit of Rs. 25.00 lakhs per unit for establishment of poultry rearing and hatching unit of at least 1,000 parent birds.
conditions_met: The scheme is open to individual farmers.
check_yourself: The scheme is open to Self-help Groups, Farmer Producer Companies, Farmer Co-operative Societies, Collective Liability Groups, and Companies registered under Rule 8.
schemes.how_to_apply: Beneficiary application and selection process through Online mode on the portal www.udyamimitra.in
